title: fix(audit): name the impersonating administrator on identity writes and on an approval decided while impersonating
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DASH6Wenq1awyqAanJTCYpU)_ Fixes #30851 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none domain:server#5 card thread · session `session_016WV4czA9H21XfNGbug1dac` · branch `claude/project-thread-xv0lyn` (named in the seat's re-posted claim on the card, with the widened file surface). Branched from `main` at 677d542a; `origin/main` merged at e603385f. Item 2 adds one optional member to a spec-owned contract (`ResumeSignal.impersonatedBy`): the dev stopped on it as the dispatch required, and the seat chose route A and one PR for both items. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:管理员代登录(模拟)某用户时,两类写入现在也记下真正操作的管理员:① plugin-auth 代 better-auth 写身份表(改名、改邮箱、成员变更、管理员路由如设置上级)时,上下文带上 `impersonatedBy`,审计行 `metadata.impersonated_by` 写管理员;② 审批决定后,流程里决定人那一段只带「这次决定」时的代登录管理员,本人决定则不带。 - 为什么改:#30213(PR #30800)已给记录写入打上代登录标记,契约复核留下两处缺口:身份表写入审计行与用户本人操作无法区分;审批恢复时决定人那段要么沿用触发时的旧标记(本人决定也带),要么代登录决定时完全不带。 - 风险与回滚:只加归属信息,`user_id`、权限、鉴权路径一概不动;spec 只给 `ResumeSignal` 加一个可选成员,且只有带服务标记(HTTP 请求体伪造不了)时才生效;回滚即 revert,无迁移。 - 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts` 的 `deciderSegmentContext`;`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-actor-attribution.ts` 的 `authSystemWriteContext` / `resolveAttributedActor`;`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` 决定入口取 `impersonatorOf(context)` 那几行。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/resume-decider-identity.integration.test.ts`,预期 32 条全绿,其中「the decider's segment names exactly the DECISION's impersonating administrator」一组覆盖本人决定、代登录决定、普通决定三种情况。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 触 `packages/spec/src/**`,席位 ACCEPT 前需契约复核)。 ## What changes **1. plugin-auth identity-table writes name the impersonating administrator.** An administrator who impersonates a user and renames them (or makes any other write better-auth performs on the user's behalf) produced a `sys_user` write credited to the user through `attributedUserId` and nothing else, so its audit row read as the user's own. Now: - `resolveActor` (`auth-manager-actor-guards.ts`) also answers the session's `impersonatedBy`, read from the session that `getSessionFromCtx` resolves or from the session row on the token fallback. Never from the request body. - The global before-hook hands the attribution scope `{ userId, impersonatedBy }`. `AuthActorResolver` may now answer that object (a bare string still means the user alone). The new export `resolveAttributedActor()` answers the user and the administrator together, and `resolveAttributedUserId()` is now a projection of it. - `authSystemWriteContext()` adds `impersonatedBy` beside `attributedUserId` (attribution only; `isSystem: true` is untouched and no `userId` appears). The adapter's `withSystemContext` now builds its write context with that same function instead of a second copy of it, so the adapter, the membership reconciler and `set-user-manager` all carry the key. - The platform-admin routes that drive better-auth programmatically (`gateAdmin` → `runAttributedToUser`) pass the admitted actor, which now carries the gated session's `impersonatedBy` (`PlatformAdminActor.impersonatedBy`, optional, set by the route's gate and never by `judgePlatformAdmin`). - The engine's `buildProvenance` already copies `ExecutionContext.impersonatedBy` onto `HookContext.provenance`, and the audit writer already stamps `sys_audit_log.metadata.impersonated_by` from it (PR #30800). The key is the one `auth-session-audit.ts` and #30800 use. **2. The approval decider's segment carries exactly the decision's administrator.** - `ResumeSignal.impersonatedBy` (new, optional, `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`). It is honoured only beside `resumedBy`, on a signal that carries `RESUME_AUTHORITY_SERVICE`, exactly as `resumedBy` is. The `AutomationContext.impersonatedBy` docblock now says what a decision does to it. - The decision door (`ApprovalService`'s decide path, `approval-service.ts`) fills it from the decision request's `ExecutionContext.impersonatedBy` (`impersonatorOf(context)`), only when there is a decider. A stranded decision's journal (`StrandedContinuationSignal`, `__strandedContinuation`) keeps it beside `resumedBy`, and `continueRestoredRun` replays it. - `deciderSegmentContext` (`run-resume.ts`) drops the trigger-time stamp on every human decider's segment and sets the decision's value. That covers (a) the `context.userId === decider` early return, which used to keep the trigger-time stamp, and (b) an impersonated decider, who used to get none. A signal with no decider (an SLA auto-decision) still keeps the run's identity and its stamp. The engine's `resolveDecisionSegmentContext` docblock says so. One changeset, all four packages `patch`. ## Tests - `service-automation/src/resume-decider-identity.integration.test.ts`: new describe "the decider's segment names exactly the DECISION's impersonating administrator, never the trigger's". It covers (a) a trigger-time stamp with the trigger user deciding in their own name → none, on both `runAs` arms; (b) an impersonated decider → the decision's administrator, on both arms, and the trigger user deciding while impersonated on an unstamped run; (c) a plain decider → none, plus a second plain decision dropping the first decision's stamp. CONTROLs: a signal without the service marker cannot name an administrator, and an administrator with no decider changes nothing. - `plugin-approvals/src/restored-approval-continuation.test.ts` (ruling A describe): approve and reject while impersonated carry `impersonatedBy: 'adm'` beside the decider; an administrator named in the decision INPUT stamps nothing; a stranded impersonated decision journals and replays it. The existing plain-decider cases now also assert the key's absence (`toEqual`). - `plugin-auth/src/auth-actor-attribution.test.ts`: the write context carries the administrator; CONTROLs for a plain session, `null` and a blank value; an administrator with no user attributes nothing; `withSystemContext` stamps writes and not reads; `runAttributedToUser` with the actor object. - `plugin-auth/src/admin-impersonate-endpoint.test.ts` (the impersonation harness): on the real better-auth pipeline, the `/update-user` rename made from the impersonation session reaches the engine with `{ isSystem: true, attributedUserId: target, impersonatedBy: admin }`, and a body key `impersonatedBy` is ignored. CONTROL: the administrator's own rename carries no key.
Ablations (each red, each restored; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs WRAP mode, git diff HEAD empty after each) | # | Mutation | Test run | Red | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | A1 | before-hook resolver answers the user id only (`main`'s shape) | `admin-impersonate-endpoint.test.ts` | 1 of 16: the impersonated rename | | A2 | `authSystemWriteContext` drops the `impersonatedBy` spread | `auth-actor-attribution.test.ts` + `admin-impersonate-endpoint.test.ts` | 4 of 34 | | A3 | self-decider path returns the persisted context (`main`'s early return) | `resume-decider-identity.integration.test.ts` | 3 of 32: (a) on both arms, and the trigger user deciding while impersonated | | A4 | the switched segment never sets the decision's value | same | 3 of 32: (b) on both arms, and the second-decision case | | A5 | the decide door does not pass `impersonatedBy` | `restored-approval-continuation.test.ts` | 3 of 24: approve, reject, stranded replay | | A6 | the journal drops `impersonatedBy` | same | 1 of 24: the stranded replay | Every ablated module is imported from `src/` by its test, so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
## Acceptance notes - **Reproduction.** Ablation A1 is the reproduction. It turns the before-hook resolver back to its `main` shape (user id only), and the real-pipeline pin then fails: the impersonated rename reaches the engine with no `impersonatedBy`. - **Not done here:** the `sys_comment` fork (a separate maintainer decision on #30213, options A/B/C). The ADR-0043 action-link decision path authenticates by token and has no session, so it carries no administrator, by construction. - **Overlap:** open PR #30717 also edits `auth-manager.ts` and `auth-plugin.ts`, in different hunks. ## Verification All readings were taken on head `b5edf8ea`, or on `8e621657` for the gate sweep. The one commit after `8e621657` edits only `auth-actor-attribution.test.ts`, and `check:query-options-erasure` plus eslint on that file were re-run on `b5edf8ea`.
Builds, typecheck, package tests - Whole-tree `turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 119/119 tasks, exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals --filter @objectstack/service-automation run typecheck`: exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 13 of 14 artifacts current. `check:test-typecheck` failed inside the wrapper with "tsc failed without diagnostics" under the default heap. Run alone with `--max-old-space-size=6144` it is OK (52 files, 240 errors, 131 pinned signatures held). No artifact moved: `ResumeSignal` is a TS interface and appears in no emitted snapshot. - `pnpm test` per package: plugin-auth 228 files, 4096 passed, 10 skipped; service-automation 264 files, 3429 passed; plugin-approvals 115 files, 1502 passed.
Gates (dispatch-gates derivation, 88 families + 3 named) - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 88 derived, 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. - The one red in the sweep was `check:query-options-erasure`: the test surface went 236 → 237 from an `as any` on a `find` call in the new attribution pin. The cast is gone in `b5edf8ea`, and the gate now exits 0 at the 236 ceiling. Its "approval-service.ts erasure count fell 10 → 4" line is the same on `main` (both trees hold 52 `as any`), so it is not this diff. - `pnpm lint` exit 0 · `pnpm check:cli-command-ids` exit 0 · `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` exit 0. - Exit-code file: `gates-ran-b5edf8ea.txt` (seat project folder).
